sentinelViolations.detail: `Eye` is imported from lucide-react but never listed in the import statement; it is used for the 'preview' command but missing from the named imports.
`Linter` is not a valid lucide-react icon export. The correct icon name would be something like `FileCheck` or `CheckSquare`; this will cause a runtime import error.
Task requires `react-router-dom Link`, but the patch imports `Link` and `Head` from `@interchained/portal-react`, which is not a standard or specified dependency.
The file is truncated mid-JSX — the component's return statement, closing tags, and default export are missing, so this file will not compile.
The page title references 'AI ASSIST' in the <Head> tag, but the app contract name is 'Portal App'; this is an unsupported brand reference in this context.
